report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with worsening fatigue over the past month affecting work, relationships, and daily functioning. Diagnosed with HIV and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, taking Biktarvy with undetectable viral load for over a year and stable CD4 count. Has tried lifestyle changes (sleep schedule, healthier eating, exercise) but fatigue persists. Expresses concern about potential long-term side effects of Biktarvy and whether it's contributing to exhaustion. Has strong support network and is open to treatment adjustments.
